Task: Click the favourite icon on a resource card in the Resource Hub
Expected Result: The favourite icon toggles its state (e.g., filled/unfilled) and the resource is visually marked/unmarked as a favourite.

Note: The task is only considered successful if the expected result is achieved; otherwise, it is deemed infeasible.
expected: The favourite icon toggles its state (e.g., filled/unfilled) and the resource is visually marked/unmarked as a favourite.
